title: Denominational, State, and Alternative Schools
grammar: Permissive vs. coercive causatives (hagy, enged vs. -tat/-tet, kényszerít)
goal: I can trace the historical shifts of Hungarian church, state, and alternative schools from Pannonhalma and Sárospatak through 1948 nationalization to 1989.
I can contrast coercive/directive causatives (-tat/-tet) with permissive constructions (hagyja / engedi, hogy...).
I can use precise vocabulary related to educational governance and autonomy.
